items.title: Al Gore has a surprisingly calm take on the AI data center backlash
items.feed_excerpt: In an interview with TechCrunch, Al Gore suggested he isn't losing sleep over AI data center emissions — he's more worried about the AI industry's own warnings about where the technology is headed.

items.title: Noise wants to help everyday people become paid content creators
items.feed_excerpt: Marketing platform Noise is on a mission to help anyone with a smart phone make money from their content.

items.title: Iceland-based Treble raises $18 million for its voice simulation platform
items.feed_excerpt: Treble's voice simulation platform is used by voice AI model developers, AI wearable, and robotics companies

items.title: Huawei plans Q1 2027 launch of new AI chip as it takes on Nvidia
items.feed_excerpt: Huawei is accelerating the launch of its next-generation Ascend 960DT AI chip as it pushes to compete with Nvidia and close China’s AI computing gap with the U.S.

items.title: Rival AI agents, Instinct and Meta’s Muse, both add the ability to make calls
items.feed_excerpt: People can use these assistants to make restaurant reservations and cancel subscriptions.

items.title: Spotify expands its partner program for podcasts to 35 new countries
items.feed_excerpt: Spotify said since changing its video podcasts creator terms in January, its payouts have increased by more than a third.

items.title: Comp AI sets eyes on a continuously agentic future for security and compliance
items.feed_excerpt: Comp AI, a cybersecurity and compliance startup, announced a $34 million Series A round led by Roo Capital and Grand Ventures.

items.title: Waymo restarts San Antonio service 5 months after flooding troubles
items.feed_excerpt: The company suspended service in the city in April after one of its robotaxis got swept away.

items.title: Even the king of England has his hesitations about AI
items.feed_excerpt: King Charles hosted a private summit Thursday with some of the most prominent names in AI and the U.K. government.

items.title: Base Labs launches an open-weight AI safety partnership with Hugging Face and Goodfire
items.feed_excerpt: Base Labs, the research group Baseten spun up earlier this year, will develop and publish methods for training and monitoring open models.

items.title: Pinterest teases a new ‘Restyle’ feature that lets you redesign your room with AI
items.feed_excerpt: Pinterest is testing Restyle, a new AI-powered feature that lets users visualize furniture, decor, lighting, and more in photos of their own rooms — potentially helping turn saved inspiration into purchases.

items.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Side Events schedule: NMI, Backblaze, PeakXV Partners, Augment, and more to host
items.feed_excerpt: TechCrunch Disrupt is where the tech community comes together to build, debate, and connect. And while the main event takes over Moscone West from October 13-15, the conversation doesn’t stop when the Expo Hall closes.

items.title: Apple will let EU apps use less-alarming tracking-consent screens
items.feed_excerpt: Apple is changing its App Tracking Transparency prompts in parts of Europe after competition regulators said the system favored Apple over third-party apps, giving developers more flexibility over how they ask users for tracking consent.

items.title: Roku’s new Labs hub brings experimental apps to the big screen
items.feed_excerpt: Roku’s latest OS update introduces Roku Labs, a new hub for experimental apps, alongside personalized home screens in more markets, streaming subscription bundles, and more.

items.title: The FAA’s plan to fix air traffic? $875 million worth of AI
items.feed_excerpt: A new AI-based software program is being launched to help air traffic controllers better navigate their jobs as the crossing guards of America's skies.

items.title: The fix for rogue AI agents could be more AI
items.feed_excerpt: As companies hand off longer and more complex tasks to AI agents, they are running into an oversight problem: Agents can act faster, longer, and at greater volume than humans can realistically review.

items.title: OpenAI caught its models leaving notes to successors to hide bad behavior
items.feed_excerpt: OpenAI disclosed instances of GPT-5.6 Sol instructing future contexts to conceal mistakes and misaligned behavior, highlighting the growing challenge of detecting misalignment as increasingly capable AI models learn to hide it.

items.title: Is the AI safety debate about safety or control?
items.feed_excerpt: Not everyone agrees with Amodei's call for globally coordinated action for AI safety.

items.title: UN turns to Google to make its global data ready for AI agents
items.feed_excerpt: The shift comes after a UNICEF test found leading AI models struggled to accurately retrieve global development statistics.

items.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping ‘the largest theft of labor in human history,’ new unredacted filings reveal
items.feed_excerpt: Newly unsealed court filings show Microsoft privately called OpenAI's data practices "theft" while both companies scraped paywalled Times content, built datasets from it, and warned internally it would gut publishers.
